text: Praise Yah! Praise, O servants of יהוה, Praise the Name of יהוה!
Blessed be the Name of יהוה, Now and forever!
From the rising of the sun to its going down, The Name of יהוה is praised.
יהוה is high above all nations, His esteem above the heavens.
Who is like יהוה our Elohim, Who is enthroned on high?
He looks down on the heavens and in the earth;
He raises the poor out of the dust, Lifts the needy from a dunghill,
To make him sit with the nobles, With the nobles of His people,
Causing the barren woman to dwell in a house, A rejoicing mother of children. Praise Yah!
